The '''droid customization kit''' produced by [[Ulqib MicroTronics]] was a [[Tool kit/Legends|tool kit]] that assisted in the modification of [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. The kit included an extensive set of tools to allow an individual to modify and enhance their droids including a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] neural pathway linkage, a [[memory modulator]], a [[memory wipe module]], replacement [[Actuator/Legends|actuators]], replacement [[Servomotor/Legends|micro-servos]], additional [[software node]], [[Broadband antenna/Legends|broadband antenna]] receiver, [[Motion sensor/Legends|movement sensor]], [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift motor]], internal [[Scomp link/Legends|computer interface socket]], two [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptors]], two [[Audio sensor/Legends|audio receptors]], [[Vocabulator/Legends|vocabulator panel]], database retrieval system, and a [[remote programming receiver]].
